description: Let \(A_n\) be maximal antichains deciding \(n\in\tau\), whose downward closures belong to the ground family. The specified positive-row name satisfies \(\dot x_B[H]=\tau[H]\cap\omega\) for every ground-generic filter \(H\). The name is chosen before \(H\), and \(\tau\) need not be forced to be a subset of \(\omega\).
